fusions.name: Barbed Sacrifice
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 9 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stinging Front
fusions.desc: Both swarms break outward, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Second Swarm
fusions.desc: Calls a second swarm that fights for 15 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second, each sting with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nectar from the Fallen
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you restore 12 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
